news.headline: Two Kings, One Booth
news.body: The two biggest rappers in New York are at war, babe. Lord Menace, the King of Steinway Street, posted Toni Treasure, 24, of Whitestone: "my queen 👑." Fifty minutes later Big Ruckus, the Boss of Ditmars Boulevard, posted Toni in the same dress, in the same Velvet Static booth: "wifey. stay out her DMs." Both men have unfollowed each other, the booth and the dress. Queens is wildin'.
news.hook: Toni's only response: a shrug emoji and "boys pls." She gained 400,000 followers by breakfast.

news.headline: Towed on Ditmars
news.previously: Lord Menace and Big Ruckus each posted Toni Treasure as his girlfriend, an hour apart.
news.body: Lord Menace dropped the first diss at midnight: "Rental Car Ruckus," about Ruckus's lime-green sports car getting towed from a hydrant outside Engine 7. The cover art is the tow receipt. Big Ruckus answered in forty minutes with "Retainer": Menace sleeps in one, and his mom, a Forest Hills dentist, still books his cleanings. Both tracks are top two on the Queens chart. Facts only, darling.
news.hook: Engine 7 confirms the tow, and that Ruckus asked the whole firehouse "not to tell anybody." They told everybody.

effects.reason: Everybody wants the booth from the photos

news.headline: Defamation by Sandwich
news.previously: The rappers traded diss tracks about a towed rental car and a retainer.
news.body: Lord Menace is suing Ditmars Deli & Dreams for C$2 million. Exhibit A is Sal's chalkboard: "THE BIG RUCKUS: double pastrami, triple cheese" right above "THE LORD MENACE: egg whites, dry toast, no salt." His lawyer, Marty Kessler-Vance, the face on the expressway billboard, calls it "sandwich-based character assassination." Sal's statement, in full: "Mira, he orders it every morning. I wrote it down."
news.hook: The court papers list the plaintiff's legal name. Lola has a copy, and she's deadass waiting for the right moment.

effects.reason: Line around the block for "The Lord Menace"

prediction.question: How does the sandwich lawsuit end?

options.label: Sal settles: free sandwiches for life
The judge makes Sal rename it

roasts.menace-wins: You picked a C$2 million payday. For egg whites. Sal laughed so hard he gave the cat a day off.
roasts.settles: You picked free sandwiches for life. Sal doesn't do free. Ask anybody who's tried to pet the cat without buying something.
roasts.rename: You picked a rename. The chalkboard stays. It's the most photographed menu in Queens now.

news.headline: Matching Robes
news.previously: Lord Menace sued Sal's deli for C$2 million over a sandwich named after him.
news.body: Big Ruckus hired his own lawyer, Gloria Szabo-Reyes ("Szabo Sues!" on every bus shelter in Queens), and is suing Talon Talk Nail Spa on Steinway Street. The claim: the spa gave Lord Menace "a better French tip." The proof leaked overnight: both rappers, same spa, same Tuesday, matching robes, cucumber slices on, ten feet apart with one curtain between them. Neither knew. Both look mad relaxed.
news.hook: The photos came from a brand-new account, @QueensReceipts. Each rapper says the other leaked them. Neither of them booked the appointment.

evidence.title: Talon Talk Nail Spa, appointment book
lines: Pink spiral book, glitter pen, one coffee ring.
11:00 · "Mr. M." Gel French tip, cucumber mask. Asked for the curtain closed.
11:00 · "Mr. R." Pedicure, paraffin dip. Asked for the curtain closed. Cried a little at the bill.
Both booked by "a friend," from the same phone number. In the margin: "she says they'll love the surprise."

news.headline: Desmond Pettibone Has Left the Building
news.previously: Big Ruckus sued a nail spa, and leaked photos caught both rappers getting pedicures side by side.
news.body: To keep suing Sal, Lord Menace had to give a deposition under his legal name. He dropped the whole case rather than say it out loud. Gloria Szabo-Reyes said it for him on the courthouse steps: Desmond Pettibone. By lunch Ruckus was selling PETTIBONE hoodies. Then Marty Kessler-Vance fired back: Big Ruckus is Gerald Fennimore III of Douglaston, former youth-orchestra oboe, owner of a Pomeranian named Princess Biscuit.
news.hook: Sal kept the chalkboard and added a third sandwich: "THE TONI: whatever he's having, on his tab." Toni goes on Real Clout FM tomorrow to tell her side.

news.headline: Toni Tells Her Side
news.previously: Lord Menace dropped his lawsuit rather than say his legal name, Desmond Pettibone, in court.
news.body: Toni Treasure cried on The Wake-Up Call: one tear, ring light on. She loves them both "in different ways, on different days," called herself "a victim of two very large men's very small feelings" and asked fans to respect her privacy, then read out her tip link twice. DJ Sharm Almight said, "I read shoutouts, not subpoenas," and both lawyers served him on air, at the same time, for "platforming." Buggin'.
news.hook: By sundown each rapper had bought Toni an apology gift: a C$40,000 diamond phone case. The same case, from the same jeweler, who says she already returned one for cash.

prediction.question: Who's behind @QueensReceipts, the account leaking both rappers' secrets?

options.label: The lawyers, for the billable hours

roasts.lawyers: You picked the lawyers. They're greedy, not organized. Different problem, babe.
roasts.cosign: You picked Lil Cosign. He can't even leave a group chat. He's still in one from 2019.
roasts.sal: You picked Sal. Sal doesn't post. Sal barely texts. Sal writes things on a chalkboard.

news.headline: Objection: They're Married
news.previously: Toni cried on the radio, and both rappers' lawyers served DJ Sharm Almight on air.
news.body: A Bayside mail carrier cracked it: Marty Kessler-Vance and Gloria Szabo-Reyes share a mailbox. They've been married nineteen years. Together they've billed the two rappers C$600,000 and just closed on a timeshare. Their statement: "A coincidence, and also a family business." Both rappers fired both lawyers and now represent themselves. Menace is suing Ruckus for "damage to the brand." Ruckus countersued for "hurtful bars."
news.hook: Toni just posted "date night tomorrow 💕" from the Ditmars Heights Rooftop. Both rappers think it's their date. Same table, same time.

roasts.menace: You picked Desmond. She liked his card. Not him. His card.
roasts.ruckus: You picked Gerald. Princess Biscuit had better odds, and Princess Biscuit bites.
roasts.sues: You picked a lawsuit. Why sue two men when you already own half of both?

beats.card_note: Voting closed. The truth drops tomorrow.

news.headline: Two Rappers, One Restroom
news.previously: The rappers' lawyers turned out to be married, and Toni booked both men for the same date.
news.body: Both rappers arrived at the Ditmars Heights Rooftop at 9 PM with two dozen roses each, saw each other, panicked and hid in the same single-stall restroom. For forty-five minutes. Kiki on the guest list timed it. Inside they compared notes: each had paid C$8,000 for Toni's grandmother's emergency dental work. Same grandmother. Same tooth. Menace's mom, the dentist, confirms that tooth doesn't exist. Odee.
news.hook: Then both men looked up the number that booked their pedicures. It was already in both phones, saved as "Toni 💕."

effects.note: The restroom where the beef ended

news.headline: Toni Treasure Owns the Beef
news.previously: Hiding in one restroom, the rappers found they'd both paid for the same grandmother's imaginary tooth.
news.body: @QueensReceipts is Toni Treasure, babe. She booked the pedicures, leaked the tow receipt, the retainer and both legal names, and made each man pay for everything twice: C$310,000 in dinners, "grandma's tooth" and phone cases returned for cash. The kicker: on their first dates, at Sal's, each rapper signed a napkin giving Toni "50% of anything that comes out of this, beef included." She owns half of both diss tracks. Sal witnessed both. Why didn't he say? "Nobody asked."
news.hook: A countdown just went up on the Clout TV Big Screen: "Toni Treasure. Tomorrow, 9 PM."

news.headline: Both of Y'all
news.previously: Toni Treasure ran the whole beef, and she owns half of both diss tracks.
news.body: Toni's debut single, "Both of Y'all," premiered forty feet tall on the Big Screen. The hook samples both men's voicemails ("baby, who's Gerald?"). Number one in Queens in an hour; the diss tracks sit at two and three, and she gets half of those too. Desmond and Gerald called a joint press conference in matching robes, then dropped their joint lawsuit when Marty and Gloria offered a couples' discount. Their new acoustic duo's first single: "We Got Played."
news.hook: Lola's sign-off: "Toni was just spotted at Velvet Static with two of Brooklyn's biggest producers. Separately. Same booth, different nights."
